hero.name: Spiros Leividiotis
hero.subtitle: Staff Product Motion Designer specializing in motion systems and design system implementation. I help teams ship motion that's consistent, scalable, and implementation ready, turning principles into patterns, guidelines, and Lottie ready handoff with design systems and engineering.

bio: I'm Spiros, a Staff Product Motion Designer based in Amsterdam, working at the intersection of product design, animation, and design systems. I use motion as a functional tool to clarify interactions, reinforce hierarchy, and improve usability at scale.

Currently at Qonto, I built the motion design system from scratch and collaborate closely with product designers, design systems leads, and engineers. I focus on building reusable, well-documented motion patterns that teams can confidently use across complex products from Rive prototypes and Lottie pipelines to motion tokens and implementation specs.

Outside of work, I spend a lot of time cycling and hanging out with Finn, my westie - who has strong opinions about walk schedules and absolutely none about motion design. I care deeply about craft, consistency, and pragmatism, and I believe great motion should feel invisible: intentional, purposeful, and grounded in real user needs.
